title: Get enabled hashtags for a TikTok account
content_data:
Use this endpoint to retrieve the hashtags that have been enabled for a TikTok account. ## Before you start - Ensure the TikTok account is a TikTok Account with Advanced Access or Verified Business Account. Learn more [about TikTok account entitlements](https://ads.tiktok.com/resources/help/article/about-tiktok-account-entitlements). To confirm this, use [/business/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-profile-data-of-a-tiktok-account/v1.3) and check whether the response parameter `has_advanced_access` is `true` for the TikTok account. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/mention/hashtag/manage/list/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Access token authorized by TikTok accounts.

To obtain an access token, use [/tt_user/oauth2/token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/mentions-api-authentication/v1.3#anchor-1).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | |business_id {Required}|string|Application specific unique identifier for the TikTok account.

You can get the ID through the `open_id` field returned by [/tt_user/oauth2/token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/mentions-api-authentication/v1.3#anchor-1).| | username {Required} | string | The username (handle) of the TikTok account. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/mention/hashtag/manage/list/?business_id={{business_id}}&username={{username}}' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #| hashtag_list | object[] | The list of hashtags enabled for the TikTok account (brand). | ##| hashtag | string | A hashtag enabled for the TikTok account. | ##| create_date | string | The date when the hashtag was enabled for the TikTok account, in the format of `YYYY-MM-DD` (UTC+0 time).

Example: `2025-01-01`. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "hashtag_list": [ { "create_date": "2025-05-21", "hashtag": "{{hashtag}}" }, { "create_date": "2025-05-21", "hashtag": "{{hashtag}}" } ] } } (/code) ```
